headline: African Airlines Report 8% International Passenger Demand Growth in September
summary: African airlines recorded an 8% rise in international passenger demand in September, the second-highest growth globally, as Nigeria added 1.19 million seats.
why: Aviation passenger volumes are a primary gauge of cross-border trade, business travel, and tourism across developing and emerging African economies.

impacts.name: African Aviation Sector
impacts.why: Carriers across the continent posted an 8% increase in international passenger demand in September.
